_comment: house-rules: ignore-file (this file lists page PATHS, and four existing slugs spell civilisation with an s; slugs are exempt from the house spelling by design). Mechanical ai-detox findings per file. A debt register, not an exemption: it must only ever shrink. A file may fall and may never rise, and a new file starts at zero. Recording a new file with a count above zero is a deliberate act and needs a reason — recovering old work is the usual one. See tools/check_prose.py for why this is a ratchet and not a gate.
reason: Baseline tightened after CATALOGUE_ROW learned the markdown-link form of the house catalogue row, synced from indy-llm-wiki. The findings that stop being counted were never prose: they are rows written as '- **[Title](page.md)** — one line' instead of '- [[Title]] — one line'. Leaving the old numbers would keep slack in the ratchet that new prose could hide in.
